params_default._note: Gallery-order feed (client request, 2026-09-04): shows appear in the order of the city's hand-set / consensus gallery list (content/curation/<city>/venue_order.json). The venue feature is the list position (1 for #1, sliding to 0 at the last listed entry; venue_rank_ref 'auto' = the number of listed venues in the registry, 110 for LA; venues off the list score 0) at weight 0.99; judge / quality / closing_soon are tie-breakers among shows at the same gallery (their combined maximum, 0.01, is about one list step). No threshold, no per-venue cap: every open gallery show is in the feed. Museums stay out of Featured (exclude_museums). Rebuild: rank_venues.py apply --city C; curate.py score + apply --city C --params content/curation/params/publish-galleryorder.json --reorder; curation_site.py build --all; webdemo/build.py.
